method: byte-count comparison of two shell commands, run on a fixed identifier list at a pinned commit

rationale.before: The honest grep-based analog to what `names` replaces: an exact, word-boundary lookup across mixed Rust/Python source. Not `bitcode search`, which is substring over name+path and answers a different, noisier question.
rationale.after: bitcode names' own stdout, the command this measurement exists to justify.

threshold.metric: aggregate byte reduction across all identifiers
